blocks.text: The Samsonite lumbar pillow is designed to bring ergonomic comfort anywhere you sit. A supportive, high-grade memory foam core adapts to your unique shape to cradle the lumbar region and encourage healthy posture. The curved profile helps your spine find a neutral position so you can work longer with less strain. This ergonomic pillow was designed with YOU in mind - A breathable mesh cover encourages airflow to keep you cooler, and the adjustable strap secures the cushion to most task chairs, car seats, and gaming chairs without slipping and you'll have an ergonomic chair ready for your needs. Add this support pillow to your must have office supplies and home office essentials list: Pair it with your black office chair to complete a clean, modern workspace while giving your back real support. Versatility is built in: use it as a back support pillow for car rides or flights, then move it to your desk for meetings and study sessions as a seat cushions for office chairs. At home, it doubles as a lumbar pillow for bed for reading or as a lower back rest pillow for sitting in bed when you want upright support for streaming or homework. Traveling? It packs easily as a compact car pillow and the supportive shape makes a great pillow for back support when you need focused relief. Pair this with your travel pillow for ease and comfort during travel, helping you feel rested and relaxed when you meet your destination. Built to go where you go, this back cushion fits office, home, classroom, and car. This lumbar support for your back will easily become a staple to your work from home essentials, home office essentials, and car essentials lists. The cover removes for easy cleaning and the slim silhouette slides into backpacks or carry-ons. Available in black and gray to blend with most setups and seating styles—from ergonomic office chairs to gaming rigs—so you can keep comfortable focus wherever you sit.
